title: Application-data marker borrowed views fast slice
mode: source-demonstrated copy avoidance with generated local controls
scope: Borrow 102 application-data group opener strings during known-group inspection
Preserve braced/unbraced marker matching and reference-remap behavior
Verify ASCII/Binary output and record framing with existing generated controls

implementation.summary: Three writer/preflight marker scans now use std::string_view over the DRW_Variant-owned opener string and a view slice when removing the optional leading brace, instead of copying a std::string and substr result for every inspection. The source group remains alive and unchanged during each synchronous scan. Added a focused selector for the existing generated common-appdata base-scope matrix.

assessment.claim: Source-level temporary string materialization was removed from the selected 102 group-name inspections. This does not measure allocations, peak RSS, or throughput.
assessment.coverage: Generated tests cover braced and unbraced known groups, entity and table records, four target versions, ASCII and Binary DXF, exact once-only group emission, reference remapping, and following-record framing.
assessment.limitations: No full suite, peer parser, CAD application, external DWG/DXF, or persistent fixture was used. The test addition only exposes an existing generated matrix through a focused selector.
